description: This file contains automated end-to-end UI tests verifying authentication behavior for a protected dashboard page, using Playwright testing framework.

methods.name: test.describe
methods.description: Defines a suite of tests related to authentication checks.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Defines an individual test case that verifies redirection for unauthenticated users.

methods.name: page.on
methods.description: Registers an event listener for console messages from the page.

methods.name: page.goto
methods.description: Navigates the page to a specified URL.

methods.name: page.url
methods.description: Retrieves the current URL of the page.

methods.name: page.waitForURL
methods.description: Waits until the page's URL matches the expected URL or times out.

methods.name: page.screenshot
methods.description: Takes a screenshot of the current page state.

methods.name: expect(page).toHaveURL
methods.description: Asserts that the page's current URL matches the expected URL.
